_comment: One finding record. The key set and types are those of the schema in Volume I §5, and scripts/check-finding-shape.mjs enforces that in CI. Findings live as an array in audit/03-findings.json — one object per check. A check with no standing_control cannot be recorded as PASS.
title: Core application security
probe: What you actually did to find out what is true — the command, the request, the attack.
evidence: Concrete, checkable artifacts: file paths, line ranges, request/response pairs, run identifiers.
Not impressions. Not 'appears to'. An assertion with no artifact behind it is NO-EVIDENCE.
claim_conflict: The claim the repository makes about itself that this finding contradicts, quoted. Null if none.
impact: What an attacker, a regulator or a user actually gets. Not a severity word — a consequence.
clone_sweep: The repository-wide search that proves this defect class has no survivors, and what it returned. A finding stays open while a clone of it remains.
human_dependency: None — or name the control that rested on a person, and cite the S-substitution applied.

structural_fix.move: The refactor that makes the defect unrepresentable rather than detectable.
structural_fix.standing_control_avoided: The policing this move would retire, forever.
structural_fix.rationale: If available and not taken, say why here. A 'no' arrived at by default rather than by decision is itself a finding.

fix: What was changed, in one sentence.
fix_change: The branch, commit or pull request carrying it.
verification: The test command and its before/after result — red before, green after, with exit codes.
mutation_score: The score on the touched module, and the threshold. Proves the test can actually fail.

standing_control.mechanism: The permanent machinery that keeps this true after the audit leaves.
standing_control.ratchet: The metric that may never regress (S11).
standing_control.calibration: How the control is itself re-proven (S12).
standing_control.demonstrated: Evidence you WATCHED it block something: re-introduce the defect, record the refusal. A control you have not seen fire is a control you are hoping about.

independent_verifier.model: A model that did not write the fix.
independent_verifier.vendor: A different vendor from the one that wrote it.
attempted: The bypasses it actually tried, named individually.

attestation: sha256:… signed provenance: model, prompt hash, spec id, policy bundle, evidence set.
